title: The Purple Crystal Winged Lion King
summary: Deep in the Magical Beast Mountain Range, Xiao Yan gathers herbs and fights beasts like a Rank Three Rock Primate while Yao Lao watches. A woman asks the Purple Crystal Winged Lion King, a Rank Six beast as strong as a Dou Huang, for its Purple Spirit Crystal. The Lion King wants to devour her instead, and they fight, her Wind's Peak, Killer Meteorite against its Purple Crystal Seal. She is sealed and wounded, and Xiao Yan hides her in his cave and treats the wounds under her vest. She gives her name as Yun Zhi, and on Yao Lao's advice he calls himself Yao Yan. He offers to help her get the crystal because they are friends, and Yao Lao tells him about the Amethyst Essence that sometimes forms when the Lion King has young. When beasts track them because she left the cave to bathe, Xiao Yan goes out alone to lure them away.
events: Xiao Yan trains and gathers herbs deep in the mountain range; he fights a Rank Three Earth Type Rock Primate.

Beasts find the cave; Xiao Yan goes out to lure them away.
